Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: After correctly finding that Margo Howard’s father is Julius (Jules) Lederer, the Planner erroneously concluded that Ann Landers’ father, Abraham B. (A.B.) Friedman, was Adam Coleman Howard’s maternal grandfather—confusing the subject’s grandmother’s father (great-grandfather) with his actual maternal grandfather.
